The Bank of Korea
Monetary Policy Decision

The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided
today to maintain the call rate target (uncollateralized overnight
rate) at its current level (5.00%) for the intermeeting period.

(The following is an English translation of the Monetary Policy Committee
statement.)

The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided
today to maintain the call rate target (uncollateralized overnight rate) at
its current level (5.00%) for the intermeeting period.

The domestic economy seems likely to maintain its upward
trend.

While investment growth continues at a low level, exports
maintain robust growth and private consumption shows a steady
increase.

There remains, however, a high degree of uncertainty
surrounding future economic developments, largely due to the run-up
in international oil prices and the possibility of international financial
market unrest.

Consumer price inflation has picked up its pace, mainly
influenced by high oil prices.

The upward trend of real estate prices
has flattened out.
In the financial markets, there is ample liquidity.

Meanwhile,
long-term and short-term market interest rates exhibit upward trends,
mainly due to changes in fund flows.
